source: The Peru Migraciones TAM Virtual campaign and the live bilingual lookup were read on 2026-08-30. The campaign says document values use letters and numbers without dots, hyphens or spaces. The live script formats the movement date as DD/MM/YYYY and exposes a 10 character maximum. Server-side error messages are not claimed.

document_type.label: Document type
document_type.help: Choose the same travel-document type used at Peru immigration control.

document_number.label: Document number
document_number.help: Migraciones instructs users to enter only letters and numbers, without dots, hyphens or spaces.

nationality.label: Nationality
nationality.help: Select the nationality recorded for the movement.

movement_date.label: Arrival or departure date
movement_date.help: The live lookup script formats this value as DD/MM/YYYY.

include_departure_record.label: Include departure record
include_departure_record.help: Use the live TAM output option when a departure movement should be included.
